description: This Java class LogWrapper implements the LogNode interface and wraps Android's native Log utility. It forwards log messages, including optional Throwable information, to Android's Log and subsequently to the next LogNode in a chain, allowing flexible log handling.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A helper class that wraps Android's Log utility, implementing LogNode and facilitating chained logging.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the linked list.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain to receive log data.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs the specified message with given priority, tag, and optional Throwable, then passes the message to the next node if present.
